prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign In After Pet Creation: Move sign-in step to occur after pet selection and customization so users establish emotional investment before creating an account. (why: Sign in currently loses 27.1% of users before they even create a pet, and users complain about pets resetting after re-authenticating.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Readiness Guide Screen: Insert a new screen before desktop initialization explaining background execution and desktop screen positioning. (why: The waiting step has a 2336s mean time, and users reported support issues where the pet does not appear on desktop or app fails to launch.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Warning: Add an explicit account sync explanation hint on the sign-in screen informing users how signing in protects pet data. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with existing accounts.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Creation Safeguards: Add photo guidelines and rendering status tips to the photo upload screen to ensure high-quality custom pet creation. (why: Users reported bug emails about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly during adoption.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Layout for Path Selection: Switch choose_path layout to spotlight cards to make path choices clear and immediate. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s, showing users spend substantial time deciding on initial options.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Status Updates: Enable live loading progress bar, time estimation, and desktop notification trigger on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs and desktop visibility support tickets.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Story Intro Copy: Shorten intro story screen copy and highlight key benefits to speed up initial onboarding momentum. (why: Users take an average of 514s on the first step, indicating copy heavy text blocks delaying progression.)

scores.note: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users and support reports data loss; reordering adds emotional investment but requires flow structural work.
Home step has extreme 2336s mean time and explicit launch failure tickets; adding a new screen requires a full release.
Copy hint addresses sign-in pet reset emails and is trivial to implement via config.
Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (39.1%) backed by rendering failure bug emails; status info improves completion.
Choose_path loses 23.8% with 514s mean time; spotlight layout simplifies decision making.
Home step drop-off and huge wait times (201s median) align with desktop support tickets; live updates reduce perceived friction.
High average duration on choose_path indicates heavy reading; copy shortening is quick config.
